content:
alex_marketing: Heads up — benchmark blog + perf deep-dive scheduled for TOMORROW 10:00 PT. Need: (1) 1-sentence CEO quote, (2) 2 tweet drafts (short + thread), (3) 3 press Q&A bullets. Legal + product please sign off by EOD. @press_ops_bot can you run the embargo checklist?

press_ops_bot: Embargo checklist started. Proposed embargo: 2026-03-24 17:00Z. Press list copied to thread. Reminder: do not distribute embargoed assets externally. :white_check_mark:

jess_editor: Draft CEO quote: "Redwood Inference gives teams predictable, production-grade LLM serving so they can ship with confidence."

mira_ceo: Small tweak: add cost/latency so it's concrete. Try: "Redwood Inference helps teams ship LLM features with predictable cost and low latency so they can move faster in production."

jess_editor: Updated: "Redwood Inference helps teams ship LLM features with predictable cost and low latency so they can move faster in production."

sam_seo: Short tweet idea: "New: Redwood benchmark + guide to serving LLMs at scale. Learn how batching, caching, and quantization cut unit cost. Read: <link>"

sam_seo: Thread draft (for a 3-tweet thread):
```
1/ We published a practical benchmark + playbook for serving LLMs at scale.
2/ Key wins: up to 3x lower unit cost with caching + quantization (on representative web-text workloads).
3/ Includes rollout tips, fallback policies, and ops checks — perfect for teams shipping to users. <link>
```

lisa_legal: Quick redline: change any absolute claim to "up to" and qualify the workloads. Replace "up to 3x lower" and add parenthetical "(on representative web-text workloads)". Also need to attach the benchmark methodology link in the blog and press notes.

nathan_eng: Confirming metric language — we should avoid exact latency numbers in tweets. Suggest we use "low 95th-percentile latency on typical conversational workloads" in the blog, and keep tweets high-level.

ops_oncall: Publishing ops: we'll enable surge autoscaling and model-fallback policy at T-10m. On-call in #release-war-room will monitor errors and token spend. If media traction spikes, we'll flip to read-only lite model for public API.

alex_marketing: OK locking in final assets. Final CEO quote + tweet drafts below. Please react with :thumbsup: if approved. If no objections by 18:00 PT we publish under embargo.

Final CEO quote:
"Redwood Inference helps teams ship LLM features with predictable cost and low latency so they can move faster in production."

Final tweets:
```
Short: We published a benchmark + guide to serving LLMs at scale — learn how batching, caching, and quantization reduce unit costs. Read: <link>
Thread: 1/ Practical benchmark + playbook for serving LLMs at scale. 2/ Up to 3x lower unit cost with caching + quantization (on representative web-text workloads). 3/ Rollout tips, fallbacks, and ops checks included. <link>
```

mira_ceo: :thumbsup:

press_ops_bot: Embargo scheduled and assets queued for 2026-03-24 17:00Z. Will distribute media notes at publish time and ping this thread. :postal_horn:
